description.value: Riverlodge is a municipally operated recreation and fitness centre in Kitimat, BC, run by the District of Kitimat. It is one of several public recreation facilities in the city, listed alongside an arena, ice rink, and aquatic centre, suggesting a substantial multi-use complex. Touring cyclists passing through Kitimat would find this a logical stop for its potential fitness and recovery amenities in a remote northern BC community.
